key_insight: DFT screening identifies condition-dependent routes to stabilize otherwise equilibrium-inaccessible MXenes, offering targeted synthesis guidance.
engineering_relevance: The dataset helps prioritize MXene candidates and synthesis conditions while providing a foundation for machine-learned stability descriptors.
method: Calculated 1,040 ordered binary and ternary bare delaminated MXenes using r²SCAN DFT.
Computed formation and decomposition Gibbs energies, decomposition products, layer symmetries, and energies above the hull.
Evaluated stability under elevated temperature, high pressure, and varying carbon chemical potential.
evidence_signal: The calculations predict stabilization of 115 predominantly carbide MXenes at 500–2000 K, 23 at 10 GPa, and three Mn–Fe–C MXenes within experimentally feasible carbon chemical potentials.
watch_item: Predicted thermodynamic stabilization does not establish experimental synthesizability; kinetics and surface terminations absent from the bare-MXene models may affect outcomes.
paper_title: High-Fidelity In Silico Dataset of Ordered Binary and Ternary MXenes with Predictive Synthesis Guidance
